notes.text: Draco is the Greco-Latin word for serpent, or dragon.
Draco is remembered as a public worker connected with Greece.
Draco's recorded life dates place this profile around -650--600.
Draco is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
Draco's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Greece historical setting.
